target: CERN CMS 2010 Run2010B 100000 educational dimuon events

split.algorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit hash of Run:Event, 20% eval, 80% reserved
split.leakageRule: All methods must compute predictions without inspecting the recorded M column; M is read only by the scoring function.

methods.name: Transverse-only muon-pair mass
methods.limitation: Massless transverse approximation omits pseudorapidity separation

methods.name: Transverse + angular fusion
methods.limitation: Massless-muon kinematic formula; near muon mass threshold may be less accurate

methods.name: Complete four-vector physics control
methods.limitation: Reproduces published mass by formula and numerical precision; not predictive evidence

methods.name: Four-port software fusion
methods.formula: same angular massless prediction; additional ports used only for diagnostics; not allowed to leak four-vector M into target prediction
methods.limitation: No target-score advantage should be claimed unless an independent estimator uses these extra inputs

evaluation.prefixedComparison: transverse vs angular fusion; angular vs four-port; four-vector reference diagnostic

guardrails: No conclusions about physical carbon toroids or quantum-spacetime emergence.
Full four-vector prediction derives from same measured kinematics as M; this is an internal consistency reference.
The four named observers are software functions on CMS data, not ALICE/ATLAS/CMS/LHCb observations of the same event.
Statistical benefit of added inputs is not equal to additional physical information being created.
Education/outreach selected dataset, not appropriate for complete particle-physics discovery claims.
dataPolicy: Never commit the large dataset; fetch source as input, report size and SHA-256 and DOI, publish only small aggregate report and analysis code.
